execution.method: Fresh isolated Python/IPython process; notebook setup compiles the clean master checkout with Maven and loads its target/classes through JPype.
execution.setup_limit: The fresh-Colab clone and package-install path was not exercised locally. The documented existing-clean-checkout path was executed, including the actual Maven compile and class-origin assertion. Python packages were installed in an isolated environment.

source_provenance.verification: Exact clean detached Git worktree from available object cache; commit identity independently verified with the GitHub connector. No production Java source edits or substituted stub classes.

engineering_validation.scope: Synthetic wellstreams: gas/oil and gas/oil/water; steady residuals and throughput, 30/60-cell uphill fixture, 120 s rate cycles with gas/oil/water/total mass ledgers, unchanged-boundary control, outer-step and spatial sensitivity, five-second gas unsplit continuation and complete serialized-state rollback.
engineering_validation.flow_assurance: Freshwater hydrate equilibrium for the wet feed with a checked pressure interpolation; deliberately cold clean-fluid path. Separate characterized heavy assay with raw wax TP-flash curves, 0.03125 K onset brackets and one-ppm mass-closure gate. Direct calcWAT output is excluded from safe-margin claims and tracked in issue #3709.
limitations: Synthetic teaching examples, without field or experimental calibration.
Hydraulic transients disable phase transfer and named-component advection; no composition-front or full thermal-energy validation claim.
120 s is early response, not complete liquid-residence-time settling.
Unsplit example is gas-only and isothermal; current multiphase riser and severe-slugging qualification gaps remain open.
Hydrate and wax calculations are equilibrium screens; no deposition kinetics, inhibitor sizing, blockage prediction or solids feedback to hydraulics.
Wax uses an explicitly separate characterized fluid from the original wellstreams.

visual_validation.renderer: nbconvert classic HTML with MathJax 3 SVG; WeasyPrint 70 and PyMuPDF page inspection
visual_validation.result: All Markdown, equations, result tables, figures and animation frames inspected. Axes and units, legends, event timing, color scales and static animation fallback are legible. Area-fraction display is explicitly distinguished from physical layer heights.

integrity_validation.targeted_repository_checker: validate_notebook(strict_execution=True, expected_code_cells=18, require_main_source=True): zero errors and warnings
integrity_validation.code_readability: All code cells AST-parsed and Black-formatted at line length 96.
integrity_validation.catalog_and_readme_links: 328 relative notebook links verified against exact GitHub base tree plus the new notebook.
integrity_validation.repository_wide_ci: To be checked on the published PR; the complete historical notebook repository was not materialized locally.
integrity_validation.pre_commit: No .pre-commit-config.yaml exists in the inspected target repository base tree.

documentation_impact.assessment: New advanced notebook documenting current master flowline and flow-assurance capabilities; no library implementation changes.
documentation_impact.scope: Source setup and provenance, units, boundary contracts, model assumptions, plots and animation, numerical checks, equilibrium-only limits, source references and reproducible CSV/JSON/image exports.
